en: Colorized vintage postcard view taken from a pergola terrace high on a hill, with a woman in early 20th‑century dress looking out over a city and a river with several bridges. Large stone columns and creeping vines frame the left foreground, while the right side shows a panoramic view of tightly packed buildings, church towers, and the river running through the city. There is printed red text at the top right reading "Pergola am Schlossberg Graz." and cursive handwriting over the sky area.
